[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members, ...), ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY, Members), ...), ... > .
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members, 'device' : Device, ...), UserY : ('device' : nils, ...), ... >
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members, 'device' : Device, ...), UserY : ('device' : Device, ...), ... > .

[B2] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device, ...), Device : ('key' : Key, ...), ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' cloudA | (Device)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device, ...), Device : ('key' : Key, ...), ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (Device ; Key) .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils, ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (Device ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key, ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : ExistingKey, ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (Device ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : ExistingKey, ... > .

[B3] < deviceA | 'key' : Key, 'on' : false, ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceA | (Key)
=> < deviceA | 'key' : Key, 'on' : true, ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA, ...), ... > < deviceA | 'on' : false, ... > $ UserX 'cloudTurnOn' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA, ...), ... > < deviceA | 'on' : true, ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY), ...), UserY : ('device' : Device, ...), ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : nils, ...), UserY : ('device' : nils, ...), ... > .
